author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Now that The Bride is officially on track to be one of the worst bombs of 2026, the blame game has started. Speaking of blame games, Rachel Zegler recently took the opportunity to blame everyone else but herself for Snow White's failure. Meanwhile, James Gunn neglected to attend the first WB meeting with new owners Paramount, sparking doubts about his future. 

Join me, MauLer, Little Platoon, Random Film Talk and Vex Electronica for Open Bar #177. 

Subscribe to Platoon: https://www.youtube.com/@TheLittlePlatoon
Subscribe to Random: https://www.youtube.com/@randomft
Subscribe to Vex: https://www.youtube.com/@VexElectronica
title: Open Bar #177 - The Bride Disaster, Zegler Meltdown, Gunn's Future
